text:
jamie: FYI MedSys (clinical ops) reported this morning that three new product squads are planning to go live this quarter. They ran a broader staging run and peak QPS hit ~2.8x our initial pilot. They want embeddings + streaming case-note summaries. Renewal ~9 weeks out. Asks: pilot dedicated capacity, PHI/on-prem options, and committed pricing examples. CC @tom @leila

 tom: Key questions: streaming latency SLO they want? Are inputs currently de-identified or full PHI? We need sample request traces (seq lengths, token rates) to size pods.

 jamie: Current feed is de-identified now; legal warned they'll likely enable PHI within 6 months. They've asked for VPC/private deployment guidance and KMS notes. I'll request a 24hr sanitized trace and 10 raw-ish example requests (we'll redact).

 leila: From eng sizing POV, we can stand up a pilot on a reserved pod (2xA100 equiv) for the squads. Need distribution: % embeddings vs generation, average tokens per request, streaming vs batch ratio. If it's heavy streaming, we'll need lower concurrency per pod.

 nina: Enablement will prepare a streaming quickstart and an example for low-latency summarization + embedding combo. Also logging cookbook for compliance teams. I'll add a slide showing caching/quantization knobs and their effect on cost/latency.

 tom: Also capture product feedback: they want team-level throughput reservations and a console toggle to show committed vs on-demand cost impact per team. That would help procurement.

 jamie: Noted. I'll log those feature asks in the backlog and tag as "sales enablement". They also requested per-route token visibility and historical latency percentiles by model.

 leila: Implementation note: soft reservations can be implemented by mapping customer teams to named pools + scheduler weights. Full isolation requires reserved pods. Could do soft layer first for faster delivery.

 nina: Renewal risk: procurement flagged price predictability as main blocker. We should present a simple committed pilot pricing that guarantees x% savings vs on-demand and a path to Dedicated.

 ops-bot: Meeting scheduled  MedSys pilot sync Thu 10:00 in #customer-success. Invitees: jamie, tom, leila, nina.

 jamie: Let's have sizing + compliance docs ready by Wed EOD. Tom can you own KMS/HSM + SOC notes?

 tom: Yep, will post a compliance packet draft by Wed noon and a tentative pod config + token-rate assumptions.

 leila: I'll run a quick sim after we get traces and provide a cost/throughput estimate by Wed EOD.

 nina: I'll prep enablement slides and a procurement cheat-sheet for the meeting.

 jamie: Thanks all  I'll upload traces as soon as Legal clears them.
